gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR adds on-demand CSV export to the reports page. The new Export CSV button downloads every column in the table, and each export reads at most 100 rows per page and stops after 4 seconds. The PR covers the button, every column, and the paging limit behind the 5-second target. The spec defers email delivery and audit-log events to acme/widgets#46. Whether exports finish under 5 seconds on production data can only be checked after merge. You are the author of this PR.

Nothing blocks merging. The test check passed in CI on the commit being reviewed. Those tests cover the header row, every column, the paging limit, the 4-second deadline, and the "not found" response for an unknown report.

One smaller point does not block merging. The export pages through rows with its own loop instead of reusing the shared paging helper in lib/page.ts, so two copies of the same logic now need upkeep (src/api/export.ts, line 31). The fix nits row can take care of it.

Approve is not offered because you cannot approve your own PR.

I recommend merge because nothing blocks it and CI passed on this commit.

1. merge - squash-merge this PR into main. [recommended]
2. fix nits - have a helper replace the separate paging loop with lib/page.ts, review the change, push it, and watch the checks once.
3. stop - end here and leave the PR and its checkout as they are.
